events.title: The Gunpowder Plot Fails
events.description: Guy Fawkes and his fellow conspirators were arrested as their plan to blow up the English Parliament collapsed. The plot had been led by Robert Catesby.
events.significance: The failed plot is still remembered every year as Guy Fawkes Night, or Bonfire Night, in Britain and some Commonwealth countries.

events.title: Frederick the Great Wins at Rossbach
events.description: During the Seven Years' War, Prussian forces led by Frederick the Great defeated the allied armies of France and the Holy Roman Empire at the Battle of Rossbach.
events.significance: The victory raised Prussia's standing as a European military power and made Frederick's reputation as a battlefield commander.

events.title: Woodrow Wilson Elected President
events.description: Woodrow Wilson was elected the 28th President of the United States. He defeated the incumbent, William Howard Taft.
events.significance: Wilson went on to lead the United States through World War I and to promote the creation of the League of Nations.

events.title: Britain and France Declare War on the Ottoman Empire
events.description: Early in World War I, France and the British Empire declared war on the Ottoman Empire.
events.significance: The declaration widened the war across the Middle East and opened new fronts that shaped the region's later history.

events.title: Kingdom of Poland Proclaimed
events.description: The emperors of Germany and Austria-Hungary proclaimed a Kingdom of Poland in the Act of 5th November.
events.significance: The proclamation was an early step toward the restoration of an independent Polish state after World War I.
